name: StableMaterial Training Configuration
definition: Finetuning procedure for StableMaterial, adapting a pretrained Stable Diffusion UNet with a custom pose/CLIP adapter for material generation.
summary: StableMaterial Training Configuration defines the hyperparameters and data pipeline for finetuning a 2D diffusion model to estimate physically plausible material properties from images, distinguished by freezing the backbone and training only a custom adapter and UNet weights.
